# Getting help

Start with the [quick start](../README.md#quick-start),
[usage guide](../docs/usage.md), and
[API reference with runnable examples](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/JohanLindvall/logfmt).

If you are stuck, [ask a question](https://github.com/JohanLindvall/logfmt/issues/new?template=question.yml).
Questions about choosing an API, handling escaped values, or reusing buffers
are welcome. Include a small example of what you want to do.

For unexpected behavior, [file a bug report](https://github.com/JohanLindvall/logfmt/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
Include the input, the function called, expected and actual output, the module
version, and `go version` / `go env GOOS GOARCH`. Replace private log data with
a sample that still reproduces the problem.

For a new capability, [suggest an improvement](https://github.com/JohanLindvall/logfmt/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)
and describe the use case. For contributing code or documentation, see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Suspected security problems belong in the private reporting channel described
in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md), including crashes or hangs on malformed input.

This is a community-maintained project; there is no guaranteed response time.
